question: Ruturaj Gaikwad became the first batsman in List - A cricket to hit how many sixes in an over?
solution:
The correct answer is __**7 sixes**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ruturaj Gaikwad** became the first batsman in List-A cricket to hit **7 sixes** in an over.
 
• This remarkable feat was achieved during the Vijay Hazare Trophy.
 
• Gaikwad's achievement broke the previous record and set a new benchmark in List-A cricket.
 
• Hitting 7 sixes in an over is a rare occurrence and showcases exceptional batting prowess.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **List-A cricket** refers to domestic limited-overs cricket competitions.
 
• The **Vijay Hazare Trophy** is an annual limited-overs cricket domestic competition involving state teams from the Ranji Trophy plates.
 
• Ruturaj Gaikwad is an Indian cricketer who has represented Maharashtra in domestic cricket and Chennai Super Kings in the Indian Premier League (IPL).
 
• Such achievements are celebrated milestones in a cricketer's career and contribute significantly to their reputation and records.
